title: Register for and pay payroll tax
what: Register with the state revenue office and pay payroll tax once wages paid in Australia pass the state's threshold.

sources.title: Understanding payroll tax
sources.quote: You must register for payroll tax if your wage bill exceeds the threshold.

triggers.unit: AUD of taxable wages a financial year (annual threshold)
triggers.note: Registration is triggered month by month, when wages pass the monthly or weekly equivalent; groups share one threshold.

sources.title: Understanding payroll tax
sources.quote: From 1 July 2025: the annual threshold is $1,000,000 the monthly threshold is $83,333.

reach.note: Every employer, by taxable wages; exemptions (e.g. some charities) are not yet recorded.

sources.title: Understanding payroll tax

confidence_note: The Act's text is only in documents the Victorian register asks automated tools not to fetch (robots.txt), so the obligation and threshold are quoted from the State Revenue Office.
